en_title: Resident Evil Requiem Star Hopes Grace Ashcroft Has 'a Long Way to Go' Even if She Won't 'Ever Be a Leon Character'
cn_title: 《生化危机：安魂曲》主演希望Grace Ashcroft「还有很长的路要走」，即使她不会「成为Leon那样的角色」
opus_summary: 《生化危机：安魂曲》中Grace Ashcroft的演员Angela Sant'Albano希望看到角色与Leon及Emily的关系继续发展。她认为Grace不会成为Leon那样的角色，但随着她更加信任并原谅自己，勇气和自信也会增长。

paragraphs.en: Grace Ashcroft actress Angela Sant'Albano doesn't think her Resident Evil Requiem hero will "ever be a Leon character," but she's still hoping "there's a long way to go with her."
paragraphs.cn: Grace Ashcroft的扮演者Angela Sant'Albano认为，她在《生化危机：安魂曲》中饰演的主角不会「成为Leon那样的角色」，但她仍希望「她还有很长的路要走」。

paragraphs.en: The person behind one of 2026's standout video game roles laid out her hopes for the future during an interview with GamesRadar . Resident Evil Requiem may only be a few months old, but she's already got a good idea of how she'd like to see Grace grow should she be asked to brave manmade horrors beyond comprehension yet again.
paragraphs.cn: 这位塑造了2026年杰出电子游戏角色之一的演员在接受GamesRadar采访时，阐述了自己对未来的期望。《生化危机：安魂曲》发售或许才几个月，但如果Grace被要求再次勇敢面对超乎想象的人造恐怖，她已经很清楚自己希望看到Grace如何成长。

paragraphs.en: Warning! Spoilers for Resident Evil Requiem follow.
paragraphs.cn: 警告！以下内容涉及《生化危机：安魂曲》剧透。

paragraphs.en: "I would really love to see how her relationship with Leon blossoms," Sant'Albano explained. "I think we have a beautiful mentorship, almost brotherly, sisterly relationship brewing. And I also want to know what happens with her and Emily."
paragraphs.cn: 「我真的很想看看她和Leon的关系会如何发展，」Sant'Albano解释道，「我认为一种美好的导师与学生关系正在形成，几乎就像兄妹关系一样。我也想知道她和Emily之间会发生什么。」

paragraphs.en: Assuming you chose the 'good' ending, Resident Evil Requiem closes with the series' one-liner expert, Leon S. Kennedy, alive and Grace taking Emily under her wing. It painted a bright future for the crew, and although it almost certainly won't last, it did give the developers at Capcom plenty of room to grow new and old characters alike.
paragraphs.cn: 假设你选择了「好」结局，《生化危机：安魂曲》结束时，系列中擅长抛出俏皮话的Leon S. Kennedy仍然活着，而Grace将Emily置于自己的庇护之下。这为众人描绘了一个光明的未来，尽管这一切几乎肯定不会持续下去，但它确实为卡普空的开发者留下了大量空间，让新老角色都能继续成长。

paragraphs.en: Despite some pretty deep roots in Resident Evil lore, Grace's story in the franchise is really only getting started in Resident Evil Requiem. So far, there's been no word on whether she'll stick around for additional entries and eventually stand toe-to-toe with other protagonists like Ethan Winters or Chris Redfield. Judging by the strong impression she made when her debut game launched in February, we wouldn't be surprised to see her back at some point down the line.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Grace与《生化危机》的背景故事有着颇深的渊源，她在该系列中的故事实际上才刚刚在《生化危机：安魂曲》中开始。到目前为止，还没有消息表明她是否会继续出现在后续作品中，并最终与Ethan Winters或Chris Redfield等其他主角并驾齐驱。鉴于她在首次登场的游戏于2月推出时给人留下了深刻印象，如果她日后某个时候回归，我们也不会感到惊讶。

paragraphs.en: Sant'Albano knows Grace could survive another run in with mutated monsters after making it through the horrors of the Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center, but will she ever be dodging chainsaws with carefully timed but stylish backflips? Not likely.
paragraphs.cn: Sant'Albano知道，Grace在从Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center的恐怖经历中幸存下来后，即便再次遭遇变异怪物也能活下来，但她会在精准把握时机的同时，用帅气的后空翻躲避电锯吗？可能性不大。

paragraphs.en: "I don't think she'll ever be a Leon character," Sant'Albano said. "She's never going to be badass, you know, doing roundhouse kicks. But I do think her courage and her self-esteem will grow the more that she trusts herself and forgives herself for a lot of the things that I think tie her down. So, I think there's a long way to go with her."
paragraphs.cn: 「我不认为她会成为Leon那样的角色，」Sant'Albano说。「她永远不会变得那么厉害，你知道的，比如使出回旋踢。但我确实认为，随着她越来越信任自己，并原谅自己身上许多我认为束缚着她的事情，她的勇气和自尊也会增长。所以，我认为她还有很长的路要走。」

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil Requiem is still so fresh, so we probably won't hear about another mainline entry like a potential Resident Evil 10 anytime soon . As if there was any doubt, that doesn't mean Capcom plans to keep players waiting for more.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机：安魂曲》仍然是一款很新的作品，因此我们可能不会很快听到另一部主线作品的消息，比如一部可能推出的《生化危机10》。不过，即便有人对此有所疑虑，这并不意味着卡普空打算让玩家一直等下去。

paragraphs.en: In 2027, fans will step back into the shoes of Resident Evil 2 hero Claire Redfield for Resident Evil Veronica . It's been a while since we last heard an update on that front following its announcement in June. We're also still waiting to hear more about the story DLC the publisher promised back in March. Maybe we could see more Grace there?
paragraphs.cn: 2027年，粉丝们将在《生化危机 维罗妮卡 重制版》中再次扮演《生化危机2》的主角Claire Redfield。自这部作品于6月公布后，我们上一次听到相关进展已经过去了一段时间。我们也还在等待发行商3月承诺的剧情DLC的更多消息。或许我们能在那里看到更多Grace的戏份？

paragraphs.en: IGN gave Resident Evil Requiem a 9/10 review . At the time of its launch, we said it "successfully splices two separate strains of survival horror together into one highly infectious new mutation."
paragraphs.cn: IGN为《生化危机：安魂曲》打出了9/10分。游戏发售时，我们称它「成功将两种不同的生存恐怖类型拼接在一起，形成了一种极具感染力的新变异体」。
